name: wims-workflow.spec-review
description: Runs all 5 voice agents in parallel against a provided spec or plan, then synthesizes findings into a prioritized revision list.

chain.description: All 5 voice agents review the spec concurrently

parallel.task: Review the provided spec or plan for infrastructure, reliability, scalability, and observability issues. Produce findings using the standard [BLOCKER | WARNING | INFO] output schema.
Review the provided spec or plan for test coverage, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and failure behavior gaps. Produce findings using the standard [BLOCKER | WARNING | INFO] output schema.
Review the provided spec or plan for auth gaps, PII leaks, audit trails, RLS, crypto, and injection vectors. Produce findings using the standard [BLOCKER | WARNING | INFO] output schema.
Review the provided spec or plan for patterns, coupling, boundaries, and maintainability issues. Produce findings using the standard [BLOCKER | WARNING | INFO] output schema.
Review the provided spec or plan for spec fidelity, requirement coverage, and user experience issues. Produce findings using the standard [BLOCKER | WARNING | INFO] output schema.

chain.description: Synthesis: read all 5 finding files, group by severity, deduplicate, produce prioritized revision list
chain.task: Read all 5 finding files from .pi/chain-runs/spec-review/. Group findings by severity (BLOCKER, WARNING, INFO), deduplicate across voices, and produce a prioritized revision list. Write the synthesis to .pi/chain-runs/spec-review/synthesis.md
